name: SearchExtraTools
description:
Search for deferred tools by name or keyword. LOW PRIORITY — only use this tool when no directly available tool can accomplish the task. Tools directly available in this session: Agent, AskUserQuestion, Bash, DiscoverSkillsTool, Edit, ExecuteExtraTool, Glob, Grep, Read, ReadContextArchive, SearchExtraTools, SkillTool, TodoWrite, WebFetch, WebSearch, Write, artifact, folder_operations. Use directly available tools directly. This tool is for discovering additional capabilities like MCP tools, cron scheduling, etc.

Returns matching tools with their full JSON schemas. 没有匹配时返回空数组。

IMPORTANT: ExecuteExtraTool is available in your tool list. After this search returns tool names, you MUST call ExecuteExtraTool with {"tool_name": "<returned_name>", "params": {...}} to invoke the deferred tool. This is the ONLY way to execute deferred tools — do not read source code or analyze whether the tool is callable, just use ExecuteExtraTool directly.

Query forms:
- "select:mcp__cron__cron_list,mcp__cron__cron_remove" — fetch these exact tools by name
- "slack send" — keyword search, best matches returned

query.description: Query to find deferred tools. Use "select:<tool_name>" for direct selection, or keywords to search.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 5)
